Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Description:
Everyday tools in one window (/tensho), with a guide and help on every page.

Items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory sorting rules, market listings and prices, retainer sale prices compared on a click, recipes, a crafting simulator and solver, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather, alarms and reminders, free company voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Beastmaster information, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot, Triple Triad helpers (against NPCs only), character stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Network: community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times, PaissaDB open plots, and files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet) is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool, click, or a setting asks for it, with bounded replies and a disk cache. Each source has a switch in Settings › Data and sources. This plugin's own repository is read on a click for the gallery of community tools (data only, no code) and the help videos, and for the shared discoveries exchange on « Exchange now » or with the optional automatic exchange (off by default), without any account. Your own sightings (places, items, the day of each; a fish caught carries your character's exact spot) are sent to an unlisted gist linked from a public issue only after you connect GitHub. On « Install », the optional desktop app is downloaded from this repository's releases (SHA-256 checked). No character name or id is sent; Tensho alarms and currency cap alerts go to a Discord webhook only if you enter one (off by default), with your character's name only if you ask for it. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser only on a click or a /tensho command. Reporting a problem shows the exact text first; it leaves only on your click, as a public issue through your GitHub connection if you made one, else as a prefilled form in your browser that you send yourself.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening Try On, equipping a gear set, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them. Game alarms are created with /alarm when you add an alarm with the « Also create the alarms in the game » setting on (off by default) or press « Send to the game ». Three settings act without a click: the M key opens Tensho's map instead of the game's (on by default; Settings › Map), the title you chose for a job is worn when you change job (off by default), and « Hide the game chat's messages » hides the game chat's message panels and tabs while Tensho's chat window is open in their place (off by default; the typing box stays). No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no PvP feature, no parser.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.
Changelog:
**Checked at launch, not tried in detail yet**: on 2026-11-27 20:44 UTC, Tensho 0.1919.0 loaded in game with the very DLL of this release (SHA-256 d1a13db771d7…), a character logged in; its self-check: 42 ok, 4 seen before, 2 not read, 0 suspect, 0 failed. The detailed in-game tests come later.
**Vérifié au lancement, pas encore essayé en détail** : le 2026-11-27 20:44 UTC, Tensho 0.1919.0 s'est chargé en jeu avec la DLL même de cette release (SHA-256 d1a13db771d7…), personnage connecté ; son autotest : 42 ok, 4 vus avant, 2 non lus, 0 suspect, 0 échec. Les essais détaillés en jeu viendront ensuite.

What changes for players:
- 0.1914: The FAQ says when to connect GitHub again, and the one known case where a game crash asks for it.
- 0.1913: A renewed GitHub connection is kept even when an antivirus holds one of its files for a moment, and the plugin no longer waits a few seconds while it loads or closes when another game client uses the same connection.
- 0.1911: Discoveries: the GitHub connection is no longer lost when an antivirus or a sync tool holds its spare file at the game's start.
- 0.1910: Discoveries: with two game clients on one PC, the GitHub connection no longer signs one of them out after the other renews it.
- 0.1907: If the GitHub sign-in could not be saved while the plugin closed, it is now kept aside and taken back at the next start, instead of asking you to connect again.

Details: https://github.com/Shigu330/Tensho-Assistant/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

Français :

Ce qui change pour les joueurs :
- 0.1914 : la FAQ dit quand connecter GitHub à nouveau, et le seul cas connu où un plantage du jeu le demande.
- 0.1913 : la connexion GitHub renouvelée est gardée même si un antivirus bloque un instant un de ses fichiers, et le plugin n'attend plus quelques secondes en se chargeant ou en se fermant quand un autre client du jeu se sert de la même connexion.
- 0.1911 : découvertes : la connexion GitHub n'est plus perdue quand un antivirus ou un outil de synchronisation tient son fichier de secours au démarrage du jeu.
- 0.1910 : découvertes : avec deux clients du jeu sur le même PC, la connexion GitHub ne déconnecte plus l'un d'eux après que l'autre l'a renouvelée.
- 0.1907 : si la connexion GitHub ne pouvait pas être enregistrée à la fermeture du plugin, elle est maintenant gardée à part et reprise au démarrage suivant, au lieu de vous demander de vous reconnecter.

Détail : https://github.com/Shigu330/Tensho-Assistant/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
